Josh — following internal legal review (Ben) and a quick sync with Product (Marissa), here’s Redwood’s preliminary position and the concrete items we need to proceed quickly. This is intended as an operational next step — Ben will provide formal legal language/examples to insert into the MSA/order form.

Redwood preliminary position (high level):
- We take allegations of third-party IP claims seriously and will engage with claimants where the MSA notice requirements are satisfied.
- Our usual indemnity posture for customer usage: Redwood will defend and indemnify Customer for third-party claims alleging that the Redwood platform (i.e., the service implementation and base model artifacts provided by Redwood) directly infringes a third party’s intellectual property, subject to the carveouts and limitations in the MSA. We do not automatically accept indemnity for outputs that result solely from customer-prompts that reproduce third-party content.

What we need from Nova (items to enable evaluation and potential defense):
1) Full copies of the claimant’s materials (signed notice and any exhibits).
2) Precise mapping of affected artifacts to API request IDs / timestamps or the raw prompt/output text. The request_id export will be sufficient for our logs matching.
3) Confirmation whether Nova provided any copyrighted materials or proprietary datasets as prompts for the relevant requests.
4) A statement of damages sought (if any) and whether Nova has received a demand for injunctive relief.

Proposed immediate mitigation steps (operational):
- If Nova can share the request_id list, Product can toggle to the conservative inference profile and enable prefix-suppression for the affected project to reduce likelihood of re-generation while we investigate.
- We recommend Nova remove or disable the specific endpoints tied to the request_ids pending review.

Redline / legal ask:
- Ben will circulate a short redline to Section 7 (IP Indemnity) that clarifies: (a) Redwood’s defense obligation for claims arising from Redwood-provided models/weights/serving; (b) exclusions for outputs that were verbatim reproductions of customer-supplied copyrighted content; and (c) a cooperation clause and notice threshold.

Proposed timeline:
- Nova provides requested materials by 2026-11-20 EOD.
- Redwood provides draft redline and formal legal position by 2026-11-22.
- If claim requires immediate legal coordination, propose a call 2026-11-20 13:00-13:30 PT — Ben to attend.

Links / attachments: HubSpot deal: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/DEAL-11872
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-novalabs-legal

Thanks — we’ll move fast once we have the request_id mapping and claimant materials.

Best,
